headline: Ravens OLB Tavius Robinson Suffers Season-Ending Pectoral Injury
summary: Ravens outside linebacker Tavius Robinson leads the team with 3.5 sacks, but he will not add any more this year. Head coach Jesse Minter announced that Robinson suffered a season-ending pectoral injury in the Ravens’ Week 6 loss to the Browns (via Jeff Zrebiec of The Athletic). headline: Jaguars’ Anton Harrison Suffers ACL Tear
summary: Anton Harrison underwent knee surgery yesterday. The procedure was aimed at setting up a return to the Jaguars late in the year, but that will not be possible. headline: Bills' Sam Franklin wins appeal; suspension for spitting reduced to fine
summary: Bills safety and special teams captain Sam Franklin Jr., has won his appeal to overturn the one-game suspension for supposedly spitting at an opponent in the win over the Raiders.
